info.cls_name: 淨零智慧學士後專班二
info.cls_ename: Post-Baccalaureate Program in College of Engineering and Science for Net Zero and Smart Sustainability

description.describe_ch: 品質工程包括：1.使產品性能對原料變異不敏感，所以，在大部分情況下，可以容忍用較差等級的原料或元件。2.使設計工作對製程變異不敏感，可以減少因再製和報廢所引發的勞工和原料成本。3.使設計工作對使用環境變異的敏感度最小，可以改善可靠度及降低操作成本。4.用一個新的結構化開發過程使得工程師的時間利用最具生產力。
description.describe_eh:
Quality Engineering aims at
1. making product performance insensitive to raw material variation, thus allowing the use of low grade material and components in mist cases,
2. making designs robust against manufacturing variation, thus reducing labor and material cost for rework and scrap,
3. making the designs least sensitive to the variation in operating environment, thus improving reliability and reducing operating cost, 
4. using a new structured development process so that engineering time is used most productively.
